name: sol10-regression-labels
goal: Preserve historical fix labels and side-bound commit links through ComparePanes.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ComparePanes migration 59d0e6edec replaced Before fix and After fix status labels with generic side headings. Normal record 55769f56 fails the existing Desktop regression history flow before repair.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing registered runtime-evidence-ui review catches the changed wording, but was pending during fixture-only checks. Strengthen its same history flow with side-scoped commit-link assertions and retain all cases and viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Formal red 4473a040ed5eaa17a12205755efd1c9c03ef75bc8b02456816adcb1290858a50 at 7007da196c fails the preserved Before fix and After fix labels across all viewports; side commit links and clicked destination stay asserted.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: RegressionProof keeps Before fix and After fix status and output labels. Both labels, hashes and links still derive from each ComparePanes side context; strengthened tests are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired green 291478240e43993212365e72f2893932395c3710e3a9caf36b54df5186d55de7 at 2c5cea1e4d passes the unchanged registered review, paired with repeated red 59f76ffb554ea9e3eb7b510d1797dc2941b20b2306e24bb3521505e27aa9d299 at 7007da196c in the same stable environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
